_notes.pools: Each stratagem lists which specialist role contributes it to the cycle pool. A stratagem only enters the cycle pool if at least one of its pool roles is active that phase.
_notes.excluded: Stratagems marked excluded: true are removed from the system entirely per community agreement. They cannot appear in any pool.
_notes.intel_lapse_rule: Intelligence Lapse is ALWAYS forced on Chaos-only missions (Vox Liberatis, Reliquary, Obelisk, Disruption, Vortex wave faction). This is a system rule, not a cascade pool draw.
_notes.faction_rule: Deployment is always Tyranid or Mixed. Never pure Chaos. Chaos-only maps convert faction via forced Intelligence Lapse.

conflict_map._notes: Defines stratagem mutual exclusions enforced at pool-generation time. category_groups: picking any member of a group blocks all others in that group from entering the same pool. specific_conflicts: named strats that block specific others regardless of category. All conflicts are bidirectional. The bot resolves conflicts before presenting the pool to the WM for confirmation.

contested_health._note: Both strats modify or remove contested Health. Pick at most one.

respawn_consequence._note: Both override the base incapacitation/respawn mechanic. Stacking produces undefined death behavior.

mission_fail_condition._note: Both add a secondary mission-fail state. Two simultaneous fail conditions are unresolvable.

ammo_cache_system._note: All three remove or fundamentally replace the standard ammo cache system. Pick at most one.

relic._note: Relic slot — only one relic type can be active per op.

headshot_modifier._note: Both modify headshot mechanics in directly contradictory ways.

ranged_distance_bias._note: Both impose ranged damage penalties at opposite distances. Stacking neutralizes all ranged damage.

melee_ranged_swap._note: Both fundamentally reweight melee vs. ranged damage in opposite directions.

close_distance_healing._note: Both provide healing to nearby allies via proximity-triggered effects. Redundant when stacked.

specific_conflicts._note: Cross-category conflicts. All are bidirectional — if A blocks B, B blocks A.

Enduring Foes.reason: Enduring Foes removes enemy incapacitation and executions entirely. All four blocked strats require executions or finishers to trigger their effects.

Measured Mercy.reason: Measured Mercy makes any death an immediate mission fail. Blocked strats either impose additional death penalties, reduce max HP in ways that guarantee deaths, or add a second conflicting mission-fail condition.

Spoils of War.reason: Spoils of War replaces the entire pickup system — resources must be earned via kills. Blocked strats either alter the same system redundantly (Scavenger, Rationing) or remove resources that Spoils of War is meant to make acquirable (Equipment Malfunction, No Apothecaries).

Survival Training.reason: Survival Training blocks all health restoration. Larraman Cells provides passive health regen. The passive regen is nullified entirely, making the strat inert.

Point Blank.reason: Point Blank boosts close-range damage by 75%. Hyperopia reduces close-range damage by 75%. Net effect is zero — both strats are rendered meaningless.

Maintain Distance.reason: Maintain Distance reduces melee damage and rewards ranged play. Myopia reduces long-range damage by 75%. Together they penalize both melee and long-range simultaneously with no compensating benefit.
